openwrt_git.betreff: ipq40xx: add MikroTik wAP ac (RBwAPG-5HacD2HnD) support
openwrt_git.text: dual-band dual-radio 802.11ac wireless access point with integrated antenna and two Ethernet ports in a weatherproof enclosure. Important: this is the new ipq40xx-based wAP ac, not the older ath79-based wAP ac (RBwAPG-5HacT2HnD). Specifications: SoC Qualcomm Atheros IPQ4018; CPU 4x ARM Cortex A7; RAM 128MB; Storage 16MB NOR flash; Wireless 2.4GHz Built-in IPQ4018 (SoC) 802.11b/g/n 2x2:2, 2.5 dBi antennae; 5GHz Built-in IPQ4018 (SoC) 802.11a/n/ac 2x2:2, 2.5 dBi antennae; Ethernet: Built-in IPQ4018 (SoC, QCA8075), 2x 1000/100/10Mb/s ports, one with 802.3af/at PoE in. Installation: Boot the initramfs image via TFTP, then flash the sysupgrade image. Notes: eth0 = physical port labeled ETH1, base MAC, can be used to power the device; eth1 = ETH2, MAC +1. Both bridged to lan by default (ports not marked LAN/WAN on the case).

openwrt_image_mk.Device/mikrotik_nor:
DEVICE_VENDOR := MikroTik
	BLOCKSIZE := 64k
	IMAGE_SIZE := 16128k
	KERNEL_NAME := vmlinux
	KERNEL := kernel-bin | append-dtb-elf
	IMAGES = sysupgrade.bin
	IMAGES += sysupgrade-v7.bin
	IMAGE/sysupgrade.bin := append-kernel | yaffs-filesystem -L | \
		pad-to $$$$(BLOCKSIZE) | append-rootfs | pad-rootfs | \
		check-size | append-metadata
	IMAGE/sysupgrade-v7.bin := append-kernel | kernel-pack-npk | \
		yaffs-filesystem -L | pad-to $$$$(BLOCKSIZE) | \
		append-rootfs | pad-rootfs | check-size | append-metadata
openwrt_image_mk.Device/mikrotik_wap-ac:
$(call Device/mikrotik_nor)
	DEVICE_MODEL := wAP ac
	SOC := qcom-ipq4018
	DEVICE_PACKAGES := -kmod-ath10k-ct kmod-ath10k-ct-smallbuffers
openwrt_image_mk.abgeleitet: mikrotik_wap-r-ac und mikrotik_wap-ac-lte erben von mikrotik_wap-ac
